response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM rental re JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = re.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.cnt) AS avg_rentals_above_avg_ratings, AVG(r.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_difference_above_overall FROM r CROSS JOIN a WHERE r.cnt > a.avg_cnt
